import datetime, json
from pathlib import Path
from common import WS, freeze_json, frozen, readonly, require, sha, write_frozen
review = WS / 'scratch-124' / 'review'
status_path = Path(r'C:\Users\stop-\AppData\Local\Temp\1794778425505-copilot-tool-output-e99cb4e4508849bf9e5c669cba45e71b.txt')
require(abs(datetime.datetime.now().timestamp() - status_path.stat().st_mtime) < 180, 'Status is stale')
status_raw = status_path.read_bytes()
status = json.loads(status_raw)
author = next(s for s in status['sessions'] if s['id'] == '968b727f-61e7-4abf-bf6a-a144903ab93a')
require((author.get('activity') or {}).get('status') == 'idle' and not author.get('is_running') and not author.get('awaiting_user_input'), 'Author is not idle for handoff capture')
handoff_path = WS / 'scratch-124' / 'reconciliation-001-handoff.json'
handoff_raw = handoff_path.read_bytes()
handoff = json.loads(handoff_raw)
require(handoff['commit']['sha'] == 'fa394d237e28df96319495a003718cc9c880a069', 'Wrong handoff candidate')
paths = [(handoff_path, sha(handoff_raw)), (WS / 'scratch-124' / 'run-reconciliation-checks.py', '1c6878b4830f8301cdfd1fd9382c4a8117692f085f9abe2e208f92a069e08612')]
for mode, expected_dir in [('author', 'reconciliation-author-gates-002'), ('committed', 'reconciliation-committed-gates-001')]:
    gate_set = handoff['gates'][mode]
    directory = WS / 'scratch-124' / expected_dir
    require(Path(gate_set['directory']) == directory, 'Unexpected gate directory')
    paths.append((directory / 'summary.json', gate_set['summarySha256']))
    for gate in gate_set['gates']:
        for kind, suffix in [('receipt', 'json'), ('log', 'log')]:
            path = Path(gate[kind + 'Path'])
            require(path == directory / (gate['gate'] + '.' + suffix), 'Unexpected gate artifact path')
            paths.append((path, gate[kind + 'Sha256']))
observations = []
for path, digest in paths:
    require(sha(path.read_bytes()) == digest, f'Changed handoff artifact: {path}')
    was_readonly = readonly(path)
    path.chmod(0o444)
    frozen(path, digest)
    observations.append({'path': str(path), 'sha256': digest, 'previouslyReadOnly': was_readonly})
failed = review / 'reconciliation-verification-run-001'
rp, lp = failed / 'receipt.json', failed / 'output.log'
r = json.loads(rp.read_bytes())
require(r['exitCode'] == r['childExitCodeAfterCleanup'] == 1 and r['memory']['breach'] is None and sha(lp.read_bytes()) == r['logSha256'], 'Unexpected failed run')
rp.chmod(0o444); lp.chmod(0o444)
status_binding = write_frozen(review / 'reconciliation-handoff-capture-status-001.json', status_raw)
print(json.dumps(freeze_json(review / 'reconciliation-handoff-capture-001.json', {'candidate': handoff['commit']['sha'], 'authorIdle': True, 'status': status_binding, 'files': observations, 'preservedFailure': {'receiptSha256': sha(frozen(rp)), 'logSha256': sha(frozen(lp)), 'reason': 'Verifier refused the writable handoff before examining the source or gate evidence.'}, 'method': 'Post-handoff byte validation and ReadOnly capture after fresh author-idle observation; not retroactive immutability or semantic acceptance.'})))
